stem:
A scientist measured the weights of squirrels in two populations. The dot plots display data from each population.

Population 1

Population 2

Which statement is best supported by the information in the dot plots?

options.label: F
options.text: The two populations have different mode weights.

options.label: G
options.text: The two populations have different median weights.

options.label: H
options.text: The data for the two populations have different skews.

options.label: J
options.text: The data for the two populations have different ranges.

visual_elements: Two dot plots showing weights of squirrels in ounces from 11 to 20, one for Population 1 and one for Population 2.
